conditions.name: Diabetic / Pre-Diabetic
conditions.description: Flags high sugar (>15g / 100g) and rapid glycemic spike ingredients (maltodextrin, liquid glucose, corn syrup)
conditions.warning_message: Contains high sugars or high-glycemic ingredients capable of triggering rapid postprandial blood glucose spikes.

conditions.name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
conditions.description: Flags elevated sodium levels (>400mg / 100g) and added salt/sodium preservatives
conditions.warning_message: Contains elevated sodium content which may exacerbate arterial pressure and fluid retention.

conditions.name: Celiac Disease (Gluten Sensitivity)
conditions.description: Strict zero-tolerance for gluten, wheat, maida, barley, rye, malt, and triticale
conditions.warning_message: Strict Celiac Contraindication: Contains gluten-bearing grains or derivatives capable of triggering small-intestinal villous atrophy.

conditions.name: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
conditions.description: Flags high sodium, potassium chloride salt substitutes (hyperkalemia risk), and inorganic phosphorus additives
conditions.warning_message: Contains added potassium or inorganic phosphate additives which can accumulate dangerously in patients with compromised glomerular filtration.

conditions.name: High Cholesterol / Cardiovascular Disease
conditions.description: Flags high saturated fats (>5g / 100g), industrial trans fats, palm oil, and hydrogenated vegetable fats
conditions.warning_message: High in palmitic acid saturated fats or industrial hydrogenated fractions that increase serum LDL cholesterol and arterial plaque risk.

conditions.name: Gout & Hyperuricemia
conditions.description: Flags purine-rich extracts (yeast extract, autolyzed yeast, hydrolyzed protein) and high-fructose syrups that accelerate uric acid synthesis
conditions.warning_message: Contains purine precursors or high-fructose sweeteners that stimulate hepatic ATP degradation into uric acid, risking painful gout flares.

conditions.name: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
conditions.description: Strict contraindication for artificial sweetener Aspartame (INS 951) and concentrated phenylalanine
conditions.warning_message: Strict PKU Contraindication: Contains Aspartame which hydrolyzes into phenylalanine, toxic for individuals lacking phenylalanine hydroxylase.

conditions.name: Lactose Intolerance
conditions.description: Flags dairy, milk solids, whey powder, lactose, cheese, and cream
conditions.warning_message: Contains dairy milk solids or lactose that may trigger gastrointestinal distress, cramping, and bloating.

conditions.name: IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome / FODMAP)
conditions.description: Flags high-FODMAP ingredients including polyols, inulin, chicory root, high fructose corn syrup, and onion/garlic concentrates
conditions.warning_message: Contains fermentable oligosaccharides, disaccharides, monosaccharides, or polyols (FODMAPs) that can exacerbate abdominal distension and pain.

conditions.name: GERD / Acid Reflux
conditions.description: Flags high citric acid, concentrated vinegar/acetic acid, high caffeine, and pungent spices
conditions.warning_message: Contains strong acidulants or pungent irritants capable of relaxing the lower esophageal sphincter and inducing acid regurgitation.

conditions.name: Fatty Liver (NAFLD / Metabolic Liver)
conditions.description: Flags concentrated fructose, liquid glucose, trans fats, and ultra-processed seed oils
conditions.warning_message: Contains concentrated simple sugars and hepatic lipogenesis stimulators that exacerbate hepatic steatosis and insulin resistance.
